sqlite3.c SHA3-256, published by upstream: 733b3fcc6cccb1e334424b9b91a9d68b618385b76ebfcbb106690bd3a9e61367
Source ID: 2026-01-09 17:27:48 b270f8339eb13b504d0b2ba154ebca966b7dde08e40c3ed7d559749818cb2075

Windows: scripts/setup-sqlite.ps1 verifies hashes then compiles .tools/sqlite/windows/sqlite3.lib.
Android ARM64: compile sqlite3.c into the native CMake target, with SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1, SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5=1 and SQLITE_OMIT_LOAD_EXTENSION=1. Odin core compiles object-only for linux_arm64 with ODIN_OS .Linux; its SQLite C symbols are resolved by the final native link. Also link Android log/android and system dl/m when required by the selected toolchain.
